svg.text: ⬇️ low-level compiler for parsing markdown without caching or blocking for long periods of time
⚖️ light-weight while implementing all markdown features from the supported flavors & specifications
🌐 works in a browser, on a server, or from a command line interface (CLI)
Node.js versions are supported. End of life Node.js versions may become incompatible with
Marked at any point in time.
